claim_seeds.evidence_preview: I wish I could be with you at Skuldafn, but I understand how important my mission is and why you entrusted me with accomplishing it.
How he defeated you in battle is beyond me, Strong-Prince.
But I'm afraid the soft living is starting to make my troops lazy.
My troops are itching to do more than maraud across the countryside.
Don't forget, Shadowscales are trained since their hatching to do one thing, and that's kill.
I can guaranteed that she has killed before, and I can also damn well guarantee she'll kill again.
The Ring of Daggers is still after me and they're closing in.
One of their agents is asking questions around Moira's Hope and I need to escape.
Called herself Apprentice Layren and begged me not to take it.
Claimed it was needed for a new shrine in Markarth.
I'm sure her wizards can confirm this is a genuine piece.

My point is, there are senche-tigers in this lair.
You are the only one I've told, but I won't be able to keep this secret exclusive for long!
The three spinners are likewise closeted and their messages are cryptic and frightening.
Just like we thought, Father was the one stealing the loaves from the cupboard.
The Demon from the East must be destroyed by a warrior filled with the spirit of Alkosh, as was always written.
It is time to end this ancient battle, as the Pride of Alkosh was always meant to.
This is our chance for the status we deserve.
As always, there are several items of note, some related to the security of the kingdom and others of a more personal nature.

At the time of my last communication, there were only a few reports of these Vaermina cultists, the Supernal Dreamers.
Our shared hopes of this being a short-lived problem were not realized.
They have been instrumental in helping me address the cultist problem and in reacting to an attempt made on the duchess' life by an Alik'r assassin.
Perhaps I should have, but the answer is still no.
Are there even any other people around Bonestrewn Crest, or is it just you and our cousins out there in the middle of nowhere?
The trip from Deshaan to Stonefalls was difficult and a little hazardous, but I made it safely.
The directions that Dethisam provided me with were perfect.
And I'll make sure the healers are ready to deal with the illness-at least as well as they're able.
Both are hardy walkers, so please triple this one's order this month.
We received word of a new Dwarven ruin discovered near Tava's Blessing and Raynor was eager to get there as quickly as possible.
And that's where we are, without a spare gold piece to our name and no prospects for getting to Hammerfell in the near future.
Pledge your forces to me and help us topple the houses of Dorell and Tamrith, or on my mother's grave I shall see the Bitterhands destroyed.
I know you were scared when you went down there, but everything will be all right.
We've gathered evidence the Ice Reach Witches are behind these harrowstorms.
The Three will be revealed as the false gods they are and Morrowind will be free!
So it is with your threats to myself and my egg-sister.
I know you are loath to give up a possible contract, but nothing is to be gained here!
Your informant was correct that no one in Daggerfall has a viable trading contract with these savages.
What he left out was that they have no desire for trade.
The conditions here are dreadful (they don't even have hot tea!) and I have been forced to sleep in my boat for over a week now.
On behalf of the Altmer, we cannot thank you enough for all that you have done for Tamriel and are honored to have you join us in the land of the High Elves.
My loyal subjects, Your Queen has exciting news to share as soon as the time is right.
Luckily, we had the resources of Rimmen Palace at our disposal, which is why you were able to beat Abnur to the hidden location.
From this point on, it is imperative that you follow the plan I outlined for you and your team exactly and without any deviation.
Are we any closer to discovering the Eye's location?
Maybe things will slow down once a new general is assigned, and then I can come home for a visit.
Considering your substantial debt to us, it is surprising to us that you are now sitting in the lap of luxury.
Adventurer, Your efforts in Elsweyr were instrumental in dealing with the Dragon threat.
This Journal was entrusted to me by an old friend, as I now entrust it to you.
Your talents are once again required, my friend.

We Altmer are disciplined and respect the chain of command.

Everybody always says the Oathbreakers are Bosmer barbarians.

If you are reading this, I know it must have been painful to fight tirelessly, only to watch your brothers and sisters fall around you.
